title.en: Seiryaku Kekkon no Otto ni "Aisanakute Kekkou desu" to Sengen Shitara Dekiai ga Hajimarimashita
Kishi Danchou wa Dansou Joshi ga Hoshikute Tamaranai - Kono Dekiai Okashikunai desu ka?
Konyaku haki sareta muhyoujou reijou ga shiawase ni naru made ~Kinmusaki no tennen tarashi kishidan-chou-sama ga torottoro ni amayakashite dekiai shite kuru no desu ga!?~
Cinderella no Ane desu ga, Fuhoninagara Ouji to Kekkon suru Koto ni narimashita ~Migawari Outaishi-hi wa Rikyuu de Slow Life wo Mankitsu suru~
Denka, Anata ga Suteta Onna ga Honmono no Seijo desu
Watashi no Konyakusha-sama no Dokuzetsu ga Sugiru ~Minna ni Shio Taiou no Hazu ga Watashi wa Dekiai Sareteimasu~
Kakure Saijo wa Zenzen Megenai: Gibo to Gimai ni Ie o Oidasareta no de Kon'yaku Haki shite Moraou to Omottara, Shinshi Datta Kon'yakusha ga Hageshiku Dekiai shite kuru you ni narimashita!?
Kon'yaku Haki o Neratte Kioku Soushitsu no Furi o Shitara, Sokkenai Taido datta Kon'yakusha ga "Kioku o Ushinau Mae no Kimi wa, Ore ni Betabore datta" to Iu, Tondemonai Uso o Tsuki Hajimeta
Shinigami Koushaku no Yatoware Tsuma ni narimashita ga, Kodomo-tachi ga Kawai sugite Mainichi Shiawase desu!
Kinou made Namae mo Yonde Kurenakatta Koushaku-sama ga, Kyuu ni Dekiai shitekuru no desu ga?
Reiketsu Ryuuou Heika no "Unmei no Tsugai" rashii Desu ga, Koukyuu ni Hikikomorou to Omoimasu
Aru Hi, Mukuchi na Konyakusha no Kanjou ga Wakaru you ni narimashita
Wakeari Hakushaku-sama to Keiyaku Kekkon Shitara, Gijou (Roku-sai) no Keiyaku Haha ni Natte Shimaimashita.
Imouto ni Konyakusha wo Toraretara Mishiranu Koushaku-sama ni Kyuukonsaremashita
Ringoku ni Koshiire shita Oujo-tsuki Mofumofu Jijo desu ga, Hontou no Oujo wa Watashi Nan desu
Zense ga Densetsu no Dai Majo Datta Fuguu Seijo wa Koutei Heika ni Dekiai Sareteimasu
Akuyaku Reijou wa Mou Zenbu ga Iya ni Natta no de, Kioku Soushitsu no Furi wo suru Koto ni shita
